Candidate destinations sharing training incidence ranked by relaxed move gain descending (including zero/negative), then block ID; take eight excluding current block. Every full-group partner considered, including previously visited groups. Accept maximum strictly positive exact gain, tie destination block then partner original ID. Shared-anchor incidence cancels exactly. Counts include fixed short tail; tail never swaps and remains last. Final block members sorted original group ID. Exact u128 objective and gains serialized as decimal strings.

Recompute whole replacement cover against unchanged remaining budget for each candidate; skip unaffordable and continue. Held anchors excluded from fit/dictionary/destinations.

Complete J>K rejection returns one covering interval per required object, not a partial plan. All mandatory, expansion and bridge groups/rows charged. Report mandatory-only cover and expanded cover.
